# blender-pbr-materials

Physically based materials in Blender 5.2 LTS+: metal/roughness rules, Principled BSDF inputs, sRGB vs Non-Color color spaces, measured albedo/F0 values from a reference table, texture-set auto-wiring with ORM packing and DirectX-to-OpenGL normal fixes, alpha and displacement rules, view transforms, and engine-ready export rules for glTF, Unreal, Unity and Roblox, with a builder script that creates the material inside Blender.
